book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page1:
§lFirst Seals§r

The magic of this world is written in scrolls. Read a scroll and the spell is yours for good.

This book is the short road from your first scroll to your own school.
book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page2:
§lScrolls§r

Look in dungeon, temple and mineshaft chests, and ask librarians and witches.

Hold right-click to read.
A duplicate: sneak + right-click for mastery XP, or right-click the altar for Aether Ink.
book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page3:
§lCasting§r

%1$s — the grimoire.
%2$s (hold) — the radial menu: assign your spells.
%3$s — cast.

Casts are instant, charged, channelled or toggled.
book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page4:
§lMana§r

Every spell costs mana; it comes back on its own, faster out of combat.

A Mana Potion is a quick top-up. Foci (wand, staff, tome) strengthen your magic.
book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page5:
§lMastery§r

Useful casts — damage, healing, control — give that spell XP.

At levels 5, 10 and 15 the spell changes: see its milestones in the grimoire.
book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page6:
§lSchools§r

The Resonance Altar binds you to one of 10 schools. Its magic grows your resonance, which brings talents and the Echo, the school's own power.

Switching is a ritual paid in ink.
book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page7:
§lHigher Schools§r

Light, Dark and Astral hide in strongholds and mansions, ancient cities and end cities.

Their first spell needs a Seal of Comprehension.
book.orbisarcana.first_seals.page8:
§lAether§r

Deep underground glows Aether Crystal ore. Its shards make ink, foci, potions and the altar.

Good luck, mage.
message.orbisarcana.observatory.solved: The glyphs align: the seals crumble and the guardians wake!
accessory.orbisarcana.needs_curios: Worn in Curios slots (mod not installed)
jei.orbisarcana.info.spell_scroll: Scrolls are not crafted. Find them in dungeon, temple, mineshaft and shipwreck chests (Light in strongholds and mansions, Dark in ancient cities, Astral in end cities), in Ruined Observatories and Flooded Scriptoria, from librarians and wandering traders, from witches and evokers. Hold right-click to learn for good. A duplicate: sneak + right-click for mastery XP, or right-click the Resonance Altar for Aether Ink.
jei.orbisarcana.info.aether_ink: Aether Ink pays for the Resonance Altar's rituals (switching school, resetting talents). Sources: crafting from aether shards and an ink sac, taking duplicate scrolls apart on the altar (1-4 by rarity), chests of the mod's structures.
jei.orbisarcana.info.aether_shard: Aether Crystal ore is found in the Overworld between y -56 and 40. It needs an iron pickaxe; Fortune gives more. Shards make ink, foci, mana potions, accessories and the altar.
jei.orbisarcana.info.resonance_altar: Right-click: bind to a school (the first time is free), switch schools with an ink ritual, reset talents. Right-click with a scroll of a spell you know: take it apart into Aether Ink.
jei.orbisarcana.info.seal: A Seal of Comprehension is the key to a higher school: it is used up by your first Light, Dark or Astral spell.
jei.orbisarcana.info.first_seals: The tutorial book: given on your first login, and it can be crafted again.
jei.orbisarcana.info.focus: A focus works while held: a wand in either hand, a staff with both hands (keep the off hand empty), a tome in the off hand. The Netherite tier upgrades the Amethyst one at a smithing table.
jei.orbisarcana.info.accessory: Worn in Curios slots: rings on the ring slot, amulets on the necklace slot. Two of the same do not stack.
